AI Overview
Slope 2 is a fast-paced 3D endless runner game where you guide a rolling ball down an infinite neon slope. 
Core Gameplay & Objectives
Goal: Keep the ball rolling forward for as long as possible without falling off the track or colliding with red blocks.
No Checkpoints: Every run resets completely upon failure, and speed increases continuously over time.
No Manual Jump: You cannot jump on command; instead, you roll over blue blocks or arrow tunnels to launch into the air or get a speed boost.
Controls: Steer left and right using the Left/Right Arrow keys or the A and D keys. 
New Features in Slope 2
Diamond Collection: Gather diamonds along the path to spend in the shop.
Ball Skins: Unlock different ball styles like a basketball, tennis ball, beach ball, or pool ball.
Local Two-Player Mode: Some versions feature a split-screen or local two-player mode to race a friend on the same track.
Dynamic Obstacles: Face sharper curves, moving launchpads, and wave-shaped tracks. 
You can play free browser versions directly on sites like Slope 2 Game or Slope 2.
